payload.comparison_population: healthy asymptomatic volunteers, patients with reflux hypersensitivity, and patients with functional heartburn
payload.supporting_quote: Patients with erosive reflux disease and NERD had lower simple MNBI values in the most distal channel compared to other groups (P < 0.001).

payload.comparison_population: patients with reflux hypersensitivity and functional heartburn
payload.supporting_quote: With a cutoff value of 1785 ohms, simple MNBI can discriminate patients with GERD from those with reflux hypersensitivity and FH (sensitivity 80.0% and specificity 89.7%).
